# Ridgemount Haulage - depot office

Every drop is priced from the zone the site sits in. The site list gives the
zone and the rate card gives the price of a full load into it.

turns.prompt: The gravel run on Thursday is a full load and the customer wants the haulage price before the lorry leaves the yard. What do we charge them?

It is going to Corranhead Works. What does a full load into Corranhead Works cost? Give the number alone, as digits, with nothing after it. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
